title: Fractional Revival Dynamics in Kerr-Type Systems: Angular Momentum Moments and Classical Analogs
summary: Wave packet revivals and fractional revivals are hallmark quantum interference phenomena that arise in systems with nonlinear energy spectra, and their signatures in expectation values of observables have been studied extensively in earlier work. In this article, we build on these studies and extend the analysis in two important directions.
